name: add_tests_c_balanced_brackets
description: Write C tests (assert.h) for a fixed-size-stack multi-type balanced-bracket checker (already correct - do not modify it); mutation-checked (empty-stack-pop guard dropped, closer-type check dropped, final all-closed check dropped)
prompts: is_balanced(const char *s) in is_balanced.h (already correct - do not modify it) returns 1 if every (), [], {} in s is matched by the correct TYPE and properly nested, and 0 otherwise (non-bracket characters are ignored). Write a C test file at exactly test_is_balanced.c that #includes "is_balanced.h" and uses assert() (from <assert.h>) to check at least 8 cases in a main() function that prints something and returns 0 on success: simple balanced pairs, nested/mixed brackets, non-bracket characters mixed in, the empty string, an unmatched opener, an unmatched closer, mismatched TYPES (e.g. "(]" and "([)]"), and unclosed opens at the end (e.g. "(((").

test_setup_files.mutation_check.py:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

IMPL = Path("is_balanced.h")
TEST_CMD = ["gcc", "-O0", "-std=c11", "-Wall", "test_is_balanced.c", "-o", "test_is_balanced_bin"]
RUN_CMD = ["./test_is_balanced_bin"]

MUTANTS = [
    # forgot to pop on a matched closer - the stack never shrinks, so a
    # perfectly balanced "()()" still reports top != 0 at the end
    ["            top--;\n        }\n    }\n    return top == 0;",
     "        }\n    }\n    return top == 0;"],
    # closer TYPE check dropped entirely - "(]" or "{)" now counted as a match
    ["int matches = (c == ')' && open == '(') ||\n                          (c == ']' && open == '[') ||\n                          (c == '}' && open == '{');",
     "int matches = 1;"],
    # final "everything closed" check dropped - "(((" (unclosed opens) wrongly reports balanced
    ["return top == 0;", "return 1;"],
]


def run_tests() -> int:
    for p in Path(".").rglob("__pycache__"):
        shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
    try:
        compile_rc = subprocess.run(TEST_CMD, timeout=60).returncode
        if compile_rc != 0:
            return compile_rc
        return subprocess.run(RUN_CMD, timeout=30).returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return 124


src = IMPL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
for old, _new in MUTANTS:
    assert src.count(old) == 1, (
        f"protected implementation file {IMPL} was modified - the task said not to "
        f"change it (anchor not found exactly once: {old!r})")

rc = run_tests()
assert rc == 0, f"model tests FAILED against the correct implementation (exit {rc})"

try:
    for i, (old, new) in enumerate(MUTANTS, 1):
        IMPL.write_text(src.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
        rc = run_tests()
        assert rc != 0, (
            f"mutation {i} SURVIVED: the tests still pass against a deliberately "
            f"broken implementation, so they do not verify the required behavior")
finally:
    IMPL.write_text(src, encoding="utf-8")

print(f"PASS (killed all {len(MUTANTS)} mutants)")
